home.title: Your real estate project, in good hands
home.lead: Whether you're buying, selling or renting, Akili supports you at every step with personalised follow-up and a deep knowledge of the local market.
home.aboutP1: Akili is a real estate agency that supports individuals and professionals in their buying, selling and renting projects. We know the ground: every neighbourhood, every type of property, every administrative step. We put this knowledge at the service of your project, with clear advice and a dedicated contact from the first conversation to the signature.
home.aboutP2: Our approach is simple: listen to you, understand your real need, and offer tailored solutions rather than a generic list of properties.
home.featureSaleText: Sell or buy with peace of mind, with full support through to the signature.
home.featureRentText: A good tenant, a good home: we handle the matching and the follow-up.
home.featureEstimateText: The fair value of your property, based on a precise knowledge of the local market.
home.featureAdviceText: Simplified procedures and clear advice, from the search to the signature.
home.ctaTitle: Have a real estate project in mind?
home.ctaText: Let's talk about it. Our team responds quickly.
